breaks.description: AC5 touch: keyboard hint also drawn
breaks.find: CenteredText(TouchControls ? "Tap II to resume" : "Press P to resume", w, h / 2 + 40, 20, White);
breaks.replace: CenteredText(TouchControls ? "Tap II to resume" : "Press P to resume", w, h / 2 + 40, 20, White); if (TouchControls) CenteredText("Press P to resume", w, h / 2 + 60, 20, White);

breaks.description: AC5 keyboard: touch hint also drawn
breaks.find: CenteredText(TouchControls ? "Tap II to resume" : "Press P to resume", w, h / 2 + 40, 20, White);
breaks.replace: CenteredText(TouchControls ? "Tap II to resume" : "Press P to resume", w, h / 2 + 40, 20, White); if (!TouchControls) CenteredText("Tap II to resume", w, h / 2 + 60, 20, White);

breaks.description: AC5 touch copy: resume to pause
breaks.find: "Tap II to resume" : "Press P to resume"
breaks.replace: "Tap II to pause" : "Press P to resume"
